about: Jorah's proactive types (docs/plan/01-vision-and-ux.md section 11, docs/runbooks/proactive.md). Every type is OFF until Adam adds it to plugins.entries.jorah-proactive.config.enabledTypes, after reading its preview card (title, trigger, channel, frequency, off). Lines of render "code" are written by code with counts and times only; render "text" lines are Jorah's own wording, checked for length and links. Edit only by commit and Adam's yes.

morning_brief.title: Morning brief
morning_brief.trigger: On a school day when your phone reports the alarm stopped; otherwise at 07:30. Not after 10:00. Needs the Morning brief automation.
morning_brief.channel: Telegram: one line with counts and times, for example "Morning brief: 2 open loops due today, 1 overdue. Woke 06:42. Detail in the Jorah app." The detail (weather, loops, the digest) is the run's session in the Jorah app or Control UI.
morning_brief.off: Say "stop the morning brief", or remove morning_brief from enabledTypes; disable the automation with openclaw --profile jorah automations disable <id>.

evening_wrap.title: Evening wrap-up
evening_wrap.trigger: At the time you set (eveningAt). Needs the Evening wrap-up automation.
evening_wrap.channel: Telegram: one line with counts, for example "Evening wrap: 1 open loop due tomorrow. 3 digest items. Detail in the Jorah app." Detail in the app.
evening_wrap.off: Say "stop the evening wrap-up", or remove evening_wrap from enabledTypes; disable its automation.

home_loops.title: Open loops when you get home
home_loops.trigger: Your phone reports arriving home, and open loops are due today or overdue. Needs the Proactive tick automation.
home_loops.channel: Telegram: "Home. 2 open loops due today. They're in the app." Counts only, never who or what.
home_loops.frequency: At most once a day, and only within the five checks and the budget of 5 pushes a day
home_loops.off: Say "stop telling me this" after one, or remove home_loops from enabledTypes.

left_home_loops.title: Open loops when you leave in the morning
left_home_loops.trigger: Your phone reports leaving home before noon, and open loops are due today or overdue. Needs the Proactive tick automation.
left_home_loops.channel: Telegram: "On your way: 1 open loop due today. They're in the app." Counts only.
left_home_loops.frequency: At most once a day, within the five checks and the budget
left_home_loops.off: Say "stop telling me this" after one, or remove left_home_loops from enabledTypes.

job_finished.title: A job you started finished
job_finished.trigger: A background job, coding job or build Adam started has finished, noticed by the heartbeat or a scheduled run.
job_finished.channel: Telegram: one neutral line in Jorah's words, at most 300 characters, no links. Detail in the app.
job_finished.frequency: Only when a job finishes, within the five checks and the budget of 5 pushes a day
job_finished.off: Say "stop telling me this" after one, or remove job_finished from enabledTypes.

job_blocked.title: A job is blocked and will lose work
job_blocked.trigger: A job Adam started is stuck on something only Adam can do (a sign-in, an approval that timed out), and waiting loses work.
job_blocked.channel: Telegram: one neutral line in Jorah's words. Held for the morning digest during quiet hours.
job_blocked.frequency: Only when it happens; no daily budget
job_blocked.off: Say "stop telling me this" after one, or remove job_blocked from enabledTypes.

learned.title: Things Jorah learned or suggests
learned.trigger: Jorah learned something worth mentioning, noticed a cost, or has a suggestion.
learned.channel: The digest only: listed in the next morning brief or evening wrap-up, never a message of its own.
learned.frequency: Whenever; read in the next digest
learned.off: Say "stop telling me this", or remove learned from enabledTypes.

project_digest.title: Daily project digest
project_digest.trigger: At 18:00 (docs/plan/11-project-mode.md section 5). Needs the Project digest automation, which calls project_digest for each project and sends one line for all of them: with one project, the tool's own line.
project_digest.channel: Telegram: one line written by code, counts and ids only, at most 300 characters and no links, for example "tree-watering-robot: 3 runs, 2 done; for you: Q-0001, I suggest B, by 2026-11-20; your hands: A-0001. Ask me for the detail." The questions with their options are in the run's session in the Jorah app, or ask Jorah.
project_digest.off: Say "stop the project digest", or remove project_digest from enabledTypes; disable its automation with openclaw --profile jorah automations disable <id>.
